# Topic Memory (Hermes Topic Memory) — Agent Integration Guide

> Cloud-hosted, topic-isolated long-term memory service for AI agents (Hermes, Pi Agent / OMP, OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code).
> Transport: MCP Streamable HTTP (`POST /mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0) and REST API (`/api/v1/*`).
> Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN>` (use a per-agent managed key from Studio; never commit or log it).

## Endpoints

- Base URL: `https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn`
- MCP Endpoint: `POST /mcp` (Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0, `Content-Type: application/json`, `Authorization: Bearer <TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN>`)
- REST Endpoints:
  - `GET /api/v1/whoami` — read shared Core / WhoAmI profile
  - `GET /api/v1/topics` — list active topics, bindings, versions, and summaries
  - `POST /api/v1/recall` — recall a high-density capsule (<= 200 chars)
  - `POST /api/v1/remember` — persist a durable fact with provenance & idempotency
  - `POST /api/v1/topics/bind` — bind a `chat_id`, `repo_url`, or `workspace_path` to an existing topic
  - `POST /api/v1/dream` — consolidate a topic (`dry_run: true` recommended before applying)
- Human Studio UI: `/studio` (API key or environment token; WeChat SSO when configured). Its **接入与密钥** tab creates keys and generates current-origin client snippets.
- This guide: `GET /llms.txt` (public, no auth required)

## Managed Keys, Roles, and Topic Scope

- `read`: `whoami`, `list_topics`, `recall`, and read-only Panel views/recall planning.
- `write`: read access plus `remember`, `bind_topic`, `dream`; no Panel administrative mutations.
- `admin`: full access including key management. SSO and `HERMES_TOPIC_MEMORY_PANEL_TOKEN` remain administrators.
- Admin `GET /api/keys` lists public metadata. `POST /api/keys` accepts `name`, `role`, optional non-empty `allowed_topics`, optional positive `expires_in_days`; its `201` response reveals `secret` once. `POST /api/keys/{key_id}/revoke` is idempotent and returns the public key record.
- Secrets are `htm_` plus 32 URL-safe random characters. Private storage keeps only SHA-256 hashes/prefixes; expired/revoked keys fail authentication. Last-use persistence is throttled to 60 seconds.
- Omit `allowed_topics` for all topics, or supply topic IDs. Listings/automatic recall candidates are restricted before reading; IDs/aliases/context outside scope fail with `403 topic_forbidden`. Role denials use `403 forbidden`; MCP returns a tool error. Core / WhoAmI remains shared.
- `GET /api/auth/me` includes authenticated `actor`, `role`, `key_id`. Ledger events, key changes, and denials identify the caller without tokens.
- Keep keys in the client's secret environment. Dismissal/logout removes the creation secret from Studio's displayed configurations; it is never saved to browser storage.

## MCP Tools (Exact Schema)

All tools are discovered via `tools/list` on `POST /mcp` (`protocolVersion: "2024-11-05"`):

1. `whoami`
   - Args: `{}`
   - Use at session start to load owner identity, preferences, and global constraints.

2. `recall`
   - Required: `query` (string, max 4096 chars)
   - Optional context: `topic`, `chat_id`, `repo`, `workspace_path`
   - Auto-routing: Context fields are optional. If omitted, the server scans the lightweight topic catalog and automatically routes to the matching topic(s), then returns a <= 200-char capsule grounded in the full topic body.

3. `remember`
   - Required: `fact` (string)
   - Optional context: `topic`, `chat_id`, `repo`, `workspace_path`
   - Optional provenance: `source_agent` (e.g. `"hermes"`, `"omp"`, `"opencode"`, `"codex"`), `source_session`, `idempotency_key`, `reason`
   - Fail-closed rule: Writes require an authoritative topic match (either explicit `topic` or a bound `chat_id` / `repo` / `workspace_path`). If no binding exists, the write is rejected instead of guessing.

4. `list_topics`
   - Args: `{}`
   - Returns active topics with `topic_id`, `display_name`, `version`, `summary`, and current bindings (`chat_ids`, `repo_urls`, `workspace_paths`).

5. `bind_topic`
   - Required: `topic` (topic_id or alias)
   - Optional: `chat_id`, `repo_url`, `workspace_path`
   - One-time setup so future `remember` / `recall` calls from a repo or workspace auto-route without passing `topic`.

6. `dream`
   - Optional: `topic` (string), `dry_run` (boolean, default `false`), `force` (boolean)
   - Consolidates duplicates, resolves contradictions, prunes noise, and refreshes catalog summaries. Always preview with `dry_run: true` first before committing.

## Client Configuration Snippets

Set environment variable `TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN` (never commit tokens into git).

### Pi Agent (`omp`) — `~/.omp/agent/mcp.json`
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "topic-memory": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer ${TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### OpenCode — `opencode.json`
```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "topic-memory": {
        "type": "remote",
        "url": "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp",
        "oauth": false,
        "headers": {
          "Authorization": "Bearer {env:TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN}"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

OpenCode's current `mcp.servers` shape uses native `{env:TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN}` expansion, not `${TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN}`. Codex's `bearer_token_env_var` is the variable name, not its value; static `http_headers` do not expand `${...}`. Studio uses a literal Bearer header only while the creation secret is visible.

Client references: [Hermes](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/reference/mcp-config-reference), [OMP](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/49dc75e819b075b9dccdb6bce5e2100195f85a00/docs/mcp-config.md), [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers/), [Codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp/). Standalone Pi uses `~/.pi/agent/mcp.json`, not OMP's directory.

### Codex — `~/.codex/config.toml`
```toml
[mcp_servers.topic_memory]
url = "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp"
bearer_token_env_var = "TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN"
```

### Hermes Agent — `~/.hermes/config.yaml`
```yaml
mcp_servers:
  topic_memory:
    url: "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer ${TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN}"
```

## Agent Operating Rules (Recommended System Prompt Snippet)

- **Start of task**: Call `whoami` if you need user preferences, and call `recall` before asking the user to repeat prior project decisions or architecture context.
- **Pass context when available**: Always pass `repo` (git remote URL, preferred — works across machines) and/or `workspace_path` when inside a code repository, or `chat_id` when inside a group chat.
- **First-time repo binding**: If `remember` fails with an unbound-topic error in a known project repo, call `list_topics` to confirm the matching topic and ask the user (or follow project policy) before calling `bind_topic`.
- **When to call `remember`**: Save durable architectural decisions, production constraints, verified root causes, and user preferences. Do NOT save transient debug logs, unverified guesses, or secrets/API keys. Always include `source_agent` and an `idempotency_key` on retries.
- **Never store credentials**: Never write API keys, passwords, tokens, cookies, or private keys into `fact`.

## Quick Smoke Test (curl)

```bash
# 1. Initialize MCP handshake
curl -fsS -X POST "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"smoke","version":"0.1"}}}'

# 2. List tools
curl -fsS -X POST "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/mcp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'

# 3. Context-free recall (no topic required)
curl -fsS -X POST "https://mindmemos-brain4-20260810.chinanorth3.cloudapp.chinacloudapi.cn/api/v1/recall" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOPIC_MEMORY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"你的问题"}'
```
